# Catalog entries no feature-coverage scene uses yet, one "<kind> <name>" per
# line. `test_tools --feature-coverage` fails when a catalog entry is missing
# from both the scenes and this list, and when a listed entry becomes used.
# A feature PR covers its new entries in a scene; list one here only under a
# comment that gives the reason (a blank line ends a group), and remove lines
# as scenes start using them.

# Material simulation: fluids, destruction worlds, heat and combustion need a
# material field and solver scene.
component MaterialFluidWorld
component MaterialDestructionWorld
component MaterialBreakProfile
component MaterialThermal
component MaterialConstitutive
component MaterialTerrain
component Combustion
component Fuel
component Igniter
component Substance
component MaterialCavity
component FragmentGlow
component MaterialFrame
component FluidVolume

# 2D lighting and sky.
component HRC2D
component Starfield2D

# Visibility queries: the rendering scene authors fog and a vision source but
# does not query sight from a behavior.
function Visibility At

# Combat, encounters and pickups: gameplay modules a combat scene would cover.
component Weapon
component Projectile
component SpawnRequest
component Encounter
component EncounterMember
component Experience
component Pickup
function Count Matching Entities

# Engine internals that scenes don't author directly.
component Drive

# Move Objects is a Studio-host service rather than a runtime catalog entry.
# Studio's OutlinerInput uses it; --outliner-move exercises its authored drop
# event and scene-move covers the scene contract. It cannot run in this fixture.

# External browsing requires an opted-in interactive host and real user input.
# Source-native-features tests the authored requests without launching websites.
function Open URL
function Cancel Open URL

# Authored utility coverage runs Utilities for four CPU frames through the normal
# controller composition. It checks Unicode text matching/ranking, typed array
# JSON encoding/query/missing/duplicate refusal, valid/invalid chords, and explicit unknown presenter width.
# Get UI View Width is reached, but an actual measured width needs a rendered
# presenter acceptance; CPU simulation does not establish layout correctness.
#
# Optional authoring packs are deliberately absent from this default catalog:
# workspace_documents, workspace_resources, workspace_assets,
# workspace_semantics, workspace_visual, authoring_platform, ui_source_sessions.
# Their ordinary utility C cases and authored Studio source compilation are
# separate coverage. Generic workspace-host runtime coverage remains pending:
# document gestures/save/conflicts, inventory refresh/path mutation, asset
# templates/identity, semantic query/refactor, visual parameter edits/preview,
# platform chooser/job lifecycle, and UI source session edit/publication.
# Do not count an absent optional pack as passed by this catalog check.
#
# Generic code-control/UI event fields are exercised by authored Studio sources
# and owning CPU tests. Rendered acceptance is still required for caret/selection,
# keyboard/focus/clipboard routing, scroll measurements, completion popup, and
# composition/IME events. Source compilation does not prove those presenter paths.

# Workspace document read-only preflight actions validate_edit/validate_candidates
# are optional authoring capabilities absent from the ordinary default catalog.
# Owning CPU cases cover redo preservation, exact-revision rechecks, absent draft
# paths and no allocation/disk publication. SDK3 authored Collaboration consumer
# is staged; generic-host room/runtime acceptance remains pending.

# Color codecs are used by authored Studio controls and are absent from this
# fixture's ordinary catalog. Owning CPU cases cover linear channel/alpha
# handling, exact packed RGBA round trips and malformed/out-of-range refusal.

# measure_ui_text requires a presenter's mounted RmlUi context and loaded fonts;
# this headless ordinary-catalog scene has neither. Owning --host-services CPU case
# checks live font shaping, dp scaling, missing targets and context retirement;
# authored Studio graph consumes it for node widths and shape-glyph sockets.

# workspace_runtime_prepare_document_scene_source is an optional authoring-host
# capability absent from this ordinary runtime catalog. Owning --host-services
# C cases cover stale base identity, unsafe virtual paths, two independent scene
# sources and refusal without replacing the current player. Installed-SDK Studio
# preview acceptance must verify compiler enqueue/poll/frozen-overlay ownership.

# workspace_runtime_subject_origin is optional authoring metadata. Owning
# --host-services C cases cover unknown host-only source origin, stale
# sessions and owned output cleanup. Frozen-source authored origin
# and spawned prototype metadata need installed-SDK prepared-session acceptance.

# workspace_runtime_prepare_document_sources is optional authoring-host source
# preparation. --host-services C snapshot cases cover bounded create-exclusive
# private overlays, conflicts and lifetime. Installed-SDK native/browser
# compile/poll and authored model preview acceptance remain separate.

# shape-glyph and vector-path require a mounted UI presenter. The ordinary
# runtime catalog fixture has no presenter. --host-services checks predecessor
# feather geometry, cubic paths, malformed input, dp scaling and invalidation
# using the actual RmlUi control with a CPU render sink. Rendered parity is
# checked separately in Studio.

# Runtime model snapshot/parameter/inspection, model action replay, runtime trace,
# and object_subject are optional authoring-host capabilities absent from this
# ordinary scene catalog. Owning --workspace-runtime C cases now include two real
# compiled/prepared model scenes, accepted and rejected parameter writes, exact
# declaration identity, owned metadata across session retirement, part/section
# intent validation, artifact-pinned action replay and scene-index token guards.
# Those cases have not been run for this source revision yet. Rendered section
# clipping and model framing still need installed-SDK native/browser acceptance.
